detailText:
"Neko Trip" allows you to obtain 3★ or higher Nekos
Each Trip can be performed using either 300 Gems or 1 Trip Ticket. Up to 10 Trips can be performed at once.
summaryText:
By going on a Trip, you can also obtain Bonus Items.
When you go on certain Trips, the number of times performed will be counted. You can earn rewards based on the total number of times performed.
precautionsText:
- Please check the [Rates] for details on which Nekos appear.
- The Nekos that appear in this Trip may include duplicates.
- Rates are listed with values rounded down to the fourth decimal place.
As a result, the sum of individual Rates may differ from the total Rate displayed.
- Due to display limitations, the total of the Rates may not equal 100%.
- Each Trip is conducted individually based on the Rates.
For example, a Neko with a 1% Rate is not guaranteed to appear once every 100 Trips.
- Please refer to the [Rates] tab for detailed Rate information.
- If the game is forcibly closed or your connection is lost after executing this Trip, 
causing the results screen to not be displayed properly, 
the Trip will still be executed correctly.
- The Nekos that appear in this Trip may reappear in the future.
- This Trip may be made available again in the future.
- There may be a limit on the number of Trips that can be performed using Gems.
For details, please check the Trip Top screen.
- The event period and contents are subject to change without notice.
- If a Neko you already have appears, it will be converted into "Neko Pieces."
